## Module Affected

- [ ] Existing resource update (link fix, better alternative)

## Evidence of Quality
Why should this be included? Consider:
- Author credibility
- Student feedback or reviews
- Alignment with module learning objectives
- Uniqueness compared to existing resources

## Accessibility Check
- [ ] Content is accessible (captions, screen-reader friendly)
- [ ] No login required (or free tier available)

Any other information maintainers should know.
